quarterly_data.signal: In its ESMO 2026 preview (45 abstracts, 11 oral presentations) Pfizer states pipeline status: a supplemental NDA for TALZENNA (talazoparib) plus XTANDI (enzalutamide) in HRR gene-altered metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer is under FDA Priority Review (TALAPRO-3); a Phase 3 study of atirmociclib in frontline metastatic breast cancer is ongoing and a Phase 3 study in early breast cancer with Roche's giredestrant is planned; tivunatamig (PF-08634404, PD-1 x VEGF bispecific) is in pivotal studies in first-line NSCLC, first-line metastatic colorectal cancer and advanced / recurrent endometrial cancer, with Phase 3 combinations including PADCEV planned; and sigvotatug vedotin is in a Phase 3 trial with pembrolizumab in first-line advanced NSCLC.
